description: Work out profit or loss on a crypto trade from buy price, quantity and an optional per-side fee percentage. Returns breakeven price always, and profit, return percentage and total fees once a sell price is given. All figures are treated as GBP. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/crypto-profit-calculator/

fee.description: Fee percentage charged on each side (default 0, must be 0 to under 100)

sell.description: Sell price per unit (optional; omit to see breakeven only)
